title: Recover gracefully from malformed Ollama NDJSON stream lines
description: Vetted from Audit #7 finding 10.5. Per-line JSON parse failures in streaming should not hard-fail the entire assistant turn. Add resilient parse handling, preserve accumulated content, and emit diagnostics for malformed chunks.

comments.author: AgentSmith
comments.body: Created from vetted findings in Data/Pages/move-to-audit.md after direct code checks across Chat.razor, ChatServices.cs, ChatToolCatalog.cs, McpController.cs, and training harness files.

comments.author: AgentSmith
comments.body: Completed malformed NDJSON resilience contract for Ollama streaming. Runtime path in `MemorySmith.App/Services/ChatServices.cs` already catches per-line `JsonException`, continues processing, and emits warning diagnostics with malformed-line count. Added focused regression test in `MemorySmith.Tests/PagesAndChatTests.cs`: `OllamaChatProvider_StreamAsync_SkipsMalformedNdjsonLinesAndPreservesOutput` to verify malformed line skipping preserves accumulated chunks/final output and logs warning (`skipped 1 malformed JSON line`). Validation: `dotnet test MemorySmith.Tests/MemorySmith.Tests.csproj -c Release --filter "Name~OllamaChatProvider_StreamAsync_SkipsMalformedNdjsonLinesAndPreservesOutput|Name~OllamaChatProvider_StreamsLiveChunks|Name~OllamaChatProvider_StreamAsync_ThrowsTimeoutWhenNoChunkArrives"` (3/3 passed).
